double-commit-for-willpower-intellect-ag.label: Double commit for [willpower] / [intellect] / [agility]
double-commit-for-willpower-intellect-ag.query: (willpower + wild >= 2 | intellect + wild >= 2 | agility + wild >= 2) & type !== "investigator"

double-commit-for-willpower-combat-agili.label: Double commit for [willpower] / [combat] / [agility]
double-commit-for-willpower-combat-agili.query: (willpower + wild >= 2 | combat + wild >= 2 | agility + wild >= 2) & type !== "investigator"

succeed-by-willpower.label: Succeed By on [willpower] tests
succeed-by-willpower.query: text ? ["succeed by", "successful by"] & text != "succeed by 0" & (text ? ["([willpower]", "[willpower])", "succeed at a skill test"] | text == "test [willpower]" | (type == "skill" & (willpower >= 1 | wild >= 1)))

succeed-by-intellect.label: Succeed By on [intellect] tests
succeed-by-intellect.query: text ? ["succeed by", "successful by"] & text != "succeed by 0" & (text ? ["([intellect]", "[intellect])", "succeed at a skill test", "successfully investigate"] | text == "test [intellect]" | (type == "skill" & (intellect >= 1 | wild >= 1)))

succeed-by-combat.label: Succeed By on [combat] tests
succeed-by-combat.query: text ? ["succeed by", "successful by"] & text != "succeed by 0" & (text ? ["([combat]", "[combat])", "succeed at a skill test"] | text == "test [combat]" | (type == "skill" & (combat >= 1 | wild >= 1)))

succeed-by-agility.label: Succeed By on [agility] tests
succeed-by-agility.query: text ? ["succeed by", "successful by"] & text != "succeed by 0" & (text ? ["([agility]", "[agility])", "succeed at a skill test", "successfully evade"] | text == "test [agility]" | (type == "skill" & (agility >= 1 | wild >= 1)))

succeed-by-support-intellect.label: Succeed By support on [intellect] tests
succeed-by-support-intellect.query: text ? ["succeed by", "successful by"] & text != "succeed by 0" & (text ? ["succeed at a skill test", "successfully investigate"] | (type == "skill" & (intellect >= 1 | wild >= 1)))

succeed-by-support-combat.label: Succeed By support on [combat] tests
succeed-by-support-combat.query: text ? ["succeed by", "successful by"] & text != "succeed by 0" & (text = "succeed at a skill test" | (type == "skill" & (combat >= 1 | wild >= 1)))

succeed-by-support-agility.label: Succeed By support on [agility] tests
succeed-by-support-agility.query: text ? ["succeed by", "successful by"] & text != "succeed by 0" & (text ? ["succeed at a skill test", "successfully evade"] | (type == "skill" & (agility >= 1 | wild >= 1)))

raise-success.label: Raise success
raise-success.query: text ? ["after revealing chaos tokens", "would succeed at a skill test"] & text = "you get skill value"

benefits-from-failing.label: Benefits from failing
benefits-from-failing.query: text ?? ["[reaction] after you fail", "play after you fail", "if this test fails", "if you fail, return"] | text = "attempt again"

benefits-from-failing-an-investigation.label: Benefits from failing an investigation
benefits-from-failing-an-investigation.query: text ?? ["[reaction] after you fail a skill test", "if this test fails"] | (text == "play after you fail" & text == "while investigating")

benefits-from-failing-an-evasion.label: Benefits from failing an evasion
benefits-from-failing-an-evasion.query: text ?? ["[reaction] after you fail a skill test", "if this test fails", "after you fail an attack or evasion"]

wants-an-enemy.label: Wants an enemy
wants-an-enemy.query: text ? ["enemy enters", "there is an enemy", "choose an enemy at your location"]

defeat-support.label: Defeat support
defeat-support.query: text ? ["you defeat an enemy", "enemy is defeated"]

attack-that-rewards-its-own-defeat.label: Attack that rewards its own defeat

take-damage-or-horror.label: Take damage or horror
take-damage-or-horror.query: text ? ["take damage", "take horror", "deal damage investigator", "deal horror investigator"] & text != "after you take" & text !== "takes 1 or more"

benefits-from-taking-damage.label: Benefits from taking damage
benefits-from-taking-damage.query: text ?? ["[reaction] after you take damage", "takes 1 or more damage"] | text = "damage is placed on"

benefits-from-damage-placed-on-it.label: Benefits from damage placed on it

benefits-from-horror-placed-on-it.label: Benefits from horror placed on it

draws-cards.label: Draws cards
draws-cards.query: (text ? ["draw card", "draw of them"] & text !== "draw the top card of the encounter deck") | (text ?? ["draw it", "draws it"] & text != "encounter deck")
